keyword: when was the last space shuttle launch
claims: The last space shuttle launch was STS-135 (orbiter Atlantis)
STS-135 lifted off at 11:29 a.m. EDT
STS-135 lifted off from NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida
STS-135 marked the final flight of the 30-year Space Shuttle Program
STS-135 delivered supplies to the International Space Station
STS-135 launched from Kennedy Space Center Launch Pad 39A
The crew of STS-135 consisted of Commander Christopher Ferguson, Pilot Douglas Hurley, and Mission Specialists Sandra Magnus and Rex Walheim
The objective of STS-135 was to deliver supplies, spare parts, and logistics to the International Space Station using the Raffaello multipurpose logistics module
The completion of STS-135 marked the official end of the Space Shuttle Program
The Space Shuttle Program ran from 1981 to 2011
